what.en: The outside accountant signs off on the books. A 'qualified' or 'adverse' opinion, or a going-concern warning, means they were not fully satisfied.
what.hi: बाहरी ऑडिटर कंपनी के खातों की जाँच करता है। 'क्वालिफ़ाइड' या 'एडवर्स' राय का मतलब है कि वह पूरी तरह संतुष्ट नहीं था।

checks.rule: Flag if the independent auditor's report contains a qualified, adverse or disclaimer of opinion, or a material uncertainty about going concern.

title.hi: ऑडिटर ने बीच में इस्तीफ़ा दिया

what.en: Auditors rarely quit early. A resignation, especially with vague reasons, has preceded several Indian collapses.
what.hi: ऑडिटर आमतौर पर बीच में इस्तीफ़ा नहीं देते। कई कंपनियों के डूबने से पहले ऐसा हुआ है।

checks.rule: Flag if the report mentions the statutory auditor resigning or a casual vacancy in the auditor's office during the year.

title.hi: मालिकों ने अपने शेयर गिरवी रखे

what.en: When promoters pledge shares for loans and the price falls, lenders can sell those shares, pushing the price down further.
what.hi: प्रमोटर शेयर गिरवी रखकर कर्ज़ लेते हैं। दाम गिरने पर कर्ज़ देने वाले शेयर बेच सकते हैं।

checks.rule: Flag if more than 10% of the promoter group's shares are pledged or encumbered (high if above 25%).

title.en: Large deals with the owner's own companies
title.hi: मालिक की अपनी कंपनियों से बड़े सौदे

what.en: Buying from or lending to firms the promoter controls can move money out of the company. Not wrong by itself, but worth reading.
what.hi: प्रमोटर की अपनी कंपनियों से लेन-देन से पैसा बाहर जा सकता है। यह अपने आप में गलत नहीं, पर ध्यान देने लायक है।

checks.rule: Flag if related-party transactions exceed 10% of revenue, or grew more than 20 percentage points faster than revenue.

title.en: Big possible bills kept off the balance sheet
title.hi: बैलेंस शीट से बाहर बड़ी आकस्मिक देनदारियाँ

what.en: Contingent liabilities are payments the company may have to make, from lawsuits, tax disputes or guarantees. They are not counted as debt.
what.hi: ये ऐसे भुगतान हैं जो कंपनी को मुकदमों, टैक्स विवादों या गारंटी के कारण करने पड़ सकते हैं।

checks.rule: Flag if contingent liabilities not provided for exceed 25% of total equity (net worth).

title.en: Profit rose, but real cash didn't
title.hi: मुनाफ़ा बढ़ा, पर असली नकद नहीं

what.en: Profit is an accounting number; operating cash flow is money that actually came in. When profit keeps beating cash, the accounts may be stretched.
what.hi: मुनाफ़ा हिसाब-किताब का आंकड़ा है; ऑपरेटिंग कैश फ़्लो असली आया पैसा है। लगातार अंतर हो तो खाते खिंचे हुए हो सकते हैं।

checks.rule: Flag if operating cash flow over the last two years is below 50% of profit over the same two years, or cash flow fell while profit rose.

title.en: Customers owe more, faster than sales grow
title.hi: बिक्री से तेज़ी से बढ़ता बकाया

what.en: Trade receivables are sales not yet paid for. If they grow much faster than sales, some sales may never turn into cash.
what.hi: ग्राहकों पर बकाया वह बिक्री है जिसका पैसा अभी नहीं आया। यह बिक्री से बहुत तेज़ बढ़े तो चिंता की बात है।

checks.rule: Flag if trade receivables grew more than 20 percentage points faster than revenue from operations.

formulas.exposure: exposure(stock) = Σ over funds of (your value in fund × fund's weight in stock)
formulas.overlap: overlap(A,B) = Σ over stocks of min(wA, wB), weights normalised to each fund's equity book
formulas.effective_funds: 1 / (vᵀ O v), v = share of your money in each fund, O = overlap matrix with 1 on the diagonal
formulas.cost: loss = V(1 + r − TER_direct)^n − V(1 + r − TER_regular)^n

principles: Numbers are calculated by code. The AI only explains and reads text.
A red flag is shown only if its quote was found on the cited page.
A red flag is a reason to look closer, not proof of wrongdoing.
For banks, lenders and insurers, the cash-vs-profit, receivables and contingent-liability checks are marked Not applicable: they are built for ordinary businesses and would give false alarms.
Your statement is read in memory and never stored. Personal details are removed before anything else sees the data.
This is an educational tool, not investment advice.

dataset.holdings_source: Fund house monthly portfolio disclosures (SEBI-mandated), as of 2026-10-31

ai_pipeline.text: Every page is read and kept with its PDF and printed page number. Tables are also rebuilt row by row from word positions, so each label stays next to its figures (plain PDF text splits them apart).
For each of the 7 checks, a search (BM25, optional dense embeddings and a reranker) picks the 6–10 most relevant passages out of 300–700 pages.
An LLM (Groq gpt-oss-120b, or Gemini Flash-Lite as fallback) reads only those passages with check-specific guidance and returns figures or a verdict, each with an exact quote and page, as JSON.
Code applies the published rule and threshold to the figures (e.g. more than 10% of promoter shares pledged). The AI never decides a warning on its own.
Every quote is matched against the cited page (and its neighbours), with every number identical. A warning with no provable quote becomes 'Unverified' and is never shown.
A different AI model re-reads the full cited pages and must agree. If it disagrees, the finding becomes 'Models disagree' and is not shown or scored as a warning.
If the AI is rate-limited or down, a rule-based reader fills in only what it can prove with a verified quote; results say which method was used.
The chat answers only from these passages and code-calculated numbers, cites [Company, p. N], and code then checks each citation and figure against the page.
Measured stage by stage against hand labels (retrieval, cited page, final verdict), plus a fake-quote test and failure drills, published on this page.

limitations: Only Indian company shares inside funds are checked. Debt, gold, overseas and fund-of-funds holdings are not.
Annual reports come once a year, so a warning reflects the latest report, not this week's news.
Only companies whose reports have been processed are checked; the report says how much of your money that covers.
The AI can miss information that is worded unusually or buried in images. Misses show as 'Not found', never as a pass.
Fund holdings are from the latest monthly disclosure and change every month.
Thresholds (for example 10% pledged) are simple published rules, not a full credit analysis.

figures.source: screener.in annual figures, standalone and consolidated (Rs crore)

fallbacks.case: Three failures in a row -> fourth answers
Every provider down -> app uses saved findings
